dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: What in the... Even that guy with amnesia could find a job, and everyone says there's tons of work lately! So why's none of it coming to me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Work doesn't come to you. You go to work.

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: And what do you know, huh? Just like those legendary adventures always sweep up their heroes by happenstance, legendary work will surely do the same...!

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: Hmph! Who'd take those cruddy jobs? Scrounging up the commissions yourself, sweating buckets, smiling till your face cracks... Only a spineless loser would sign up for that garbage!

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: ...Curses. Could that woman be sabotaging me...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Commissions that "find" you tend to be the dangerous ones...

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: So what? Nobody ever made a pretty penny without getting their fingers dirty. The bigger the risk, the bigger the reward...

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: Besides, clients who post those kinds of requests would never demand you "smile the whole blasted time" or whine, "Hey, what's with the attitude?!" — they only care about professional results.

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: *sigh*... A lucrative job like that could keep me fed for months... Which makes the recent drought even more depressing. Where are all the good jobs...?

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: You! Do you have any commissions for me!? If not, get lost.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't let me get in the way of your receiving work, then...

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: Hmph...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "That woman"?

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: That woman, you know, *that* woman... I—I'm not going to say her name out loud, you never know if someone from the Curatorium of Secrets might be listening in... She claimed I had a "bad reputation" or something from my adventurer days...

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: I mean, come on! I helped my client dig up three whole lost boxes of Mora. It was tiring, I nearly lost my life, and, what, they still wanted me to kneel, smile, and hand over the loot with both hands!?

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: "You smashed the box onto his face," yeah, right! Get a load of her, mouthing off like she was actually there... All I did was give it over a little forcefully...

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: ...Curse it all. What rotten luck I have... Alright, don't stand in my way, or you might scare some potential clients away.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like it's a you problem, no?

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: Me? I sell my strength, and clients pay me in Mora. What problem is there in wanting a fair trade?

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: "Make the client feel special!" "Give them warm fuzzies for hiring you!" Shut up, shut up, SHUT UP! The people who spout this drivel are the real scourge of the bounty hunting industry!

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Ugh, alright... Look, if you don't have any work to offer, just... don't bother me. Maybe my next big break's already walking down the street as we speak...

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: L—Lady Nefer...!

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Looks like you've come into some money lately. Have you been picking up commissions?

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: Yes... But how did you know?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Well, my little birds told me just a thing or two. Back home, we say the moon doesn't stay hidden behind the clouds forever... wouldn't you agree?

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: Oh! Well, y—you know, L—Lady Nefer, I—I...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: No need to stiffen up, Mr. Gaudenty. You've seen to those commissions well enough, and that alone is quite satisfactory in my books.

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: ...Wait, were those commissions...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Each of us has our own strengths — learn how to use yours and you won't go hungry.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Goodbye, Mr. Gaudenty. I wish you all the best.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Work doesn't come to you. You go to work.

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: And what do you know, huh? Just like those legendary adventures always sweep up their heroes by happenstance, legendary work will surely do the same...!

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: Hmph! Who'd take those cruddy jobs? Scrounging up the commissions yourself, sweating buckets, smiling till your face cracks... Only a spineless loser would sign up for that garbage!

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: Blast it... To think those commissions I took before... It was all that woman's doing!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "That woman"?

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: Who else? Huh! What's it matter? She knows anyway... Nefer... Um, I mean, Lady Nefer!

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: She didn't tell me outright, but those escort commissions I completed... She must've set them up for me!

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: B—But how did she do it!? Surely the Adventurers' Guild isn't taking orders from her? That can't be...

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, a fella needs to eat, so I guess I have no choice... But once I've built my reputation back up...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Commissions that "find" you tend to be the dangerous ones...

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: So what? Nobody ever made a pretty penny without getting their fingers dirty. The bigger the risk, the bigger the reward...

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: Besides, clients who post those kinds of requests would never demand you "smile the whole blasted time" or whine, "Hey, what's with the attitude?!" — they only care about professional results.

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: Wait a second... No wonder those commissions where I was picked out specially were so much trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: Wait, does she think this kind of commission is all I'm good for? Blast it!
